name: 银白断锋
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: reusable transparent PNG foreground for the CENTRAL VS emblem in a character-versus music edit. Create a SINGLE finished emblem, not a poster or mockup. Exact and only text: "VS", two clear uppercase Latin letters, V followed by S. Square 1024x1024 canvas, compact wide emblem centered in the middle, transparent clear margins on every side; design occupies roughly 78% width and 48% height. Real native alpha transparency everywhere outside the typography and a few compact adjacent accent shapes, including the interior openings of letters. No background, no gray/white checkerboard pattern baked into pixels, no rectangle, no giant opaque badge, no characters, no extra words, no watermark. Bold instantly readable silhouette at 180px width, professional bespoke esports / film battle branding, keep sharp edges and controlled decorative extent. Avoid gold or yellow; avoid huge fire, smoke, long beams, circles that hide character footage.
Design direction: sculpted SILVER TITANIUM / gunmetal blockbuster lettering. Heavy custom forward-leaning VS, powerful geometric diagonal cuts, close spacing, polished pale silver front faces, subtle brushed steel, dark narrow beveled sides and a crisp charcoal outer edge for contrast over light or dark footage. Subtle asymmetrical split notch between V and S. Two very short fractured metal wedges echo the same diagonal at opposite sides. Luxury precision and real metallic relief, restrained texture, high readability; typography itself is the entire composition, not mounted on a plate.
